Subject: Inference cost qualification & benchmarking — HealthSync next steps

Hi Alice / Sam,

Thanks again for the call today — good to meet the team. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we’re aligned on pricing assumptions.

Recap of what you shared (please correct me if I misstate):
- Monthly token volume (combined input+output): ~150M — 300M tokens/month.
- Production timeline: pilot in Q3 (1–2m tokens/day), expansion late Q4 if pilot meets latency & cost goals.
- Primary workload: clinical summarization + query answer generation (long contexts, average seq len ~1200 tokens).
- Budget guardrail: procurement wants to see unit economics in the $/1M token range to justify a hosted pilot before committing to reserved capacity.

Initial benchmarking (ballpark for discussion):
- OpenAI (public host reference): approx $48 / 1M tokens for the model class you referenced (generation+context).
- Anthropic: ~ $38 / 1M tokens.
- Generic open-model hosts (quantized, multi-tenant): often seen in the $20 - $28 / 1M range for optimized Llama-family variants.
- Redwood target (what we can propose):
  - Hosted pilot: $18 - $25 / 1M tokens depending on SLA and streaming needs.
  - 1yr reserved (dedicated pool): can push to $12 - $16 / 1M with commit + burst allowances.

Asks / next steps for us to model a firm proposal:
1) Can you confirm the average request/response token split? (e.g., 30% input / 70% output or similar)
2) What peak QPS should we model for the pilot (and what latency SLO would be considered acceptable)?
3) Procurement timeline & legal contacts if you want us to include pre-filled T&Cs with the proposal.

I attached a quick "pricing_scenarios.xlsx" with three starter models (hosted vs 1-yr reserved vs aggressive reserve) — I’ll update with your answers and send a tailored one-pager.

Proposed cadence:
- You answer the three asks above by EOD Wed 7/7 -> I’ll return a modeled price sheet + recommended guardrails by Fri 7/9.
- If numbers look good, we’ll scope a 30-day pilot and provide a detailed MA/Procurement checklist for the pilot contract.

Thanks — happy to hop on 15m tomorrow if it speeds things up.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Field Sales, Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful and mostly accurate. A couple of clarifications from our side:
- Token split: closer to 40% input, 60% output for our average summarization tasks. Some requests (multi-document summarize) spike output tokens.
- Pilot peak: plan for bursts to ~15 QPS with target median latency <450ms; P95 <800ms is negotiable during pilot.
- Procurement timeline: we want pricing laid out by 7/12 to review with procurement the following week; legal contact will be Sam Finney (cc’d).

Specific asks for the price sheet:
1) Please include an example P&L row that converts $/1M tokens to $/monthly for our baseline 200M tokens/mo and a second row for 300M tokens/mo.
2) Show a 12-month reserved scenario with a 30% discount from your hosted list price and separate overage pricing.
3) If possible, include an apples-to-apples column that adjusts for model-class differences (i.e., using a slightly faster, quantized Llama-v2 variant vs a larger base model) — we want to understand quality tradeoffs.

If you can get a modeled sheet + a 1-page executive summary by 7/9 that would be great.

— Alice
